hits.title: RSIBench-Infra: Can Agents Optimize Their Own Training and Inference Infrastructure at Production Scale?

hits.title: Improved Bounds for Online TSP on the Half-Line
hits.abstract_snippet: In the open online traveling salesperson problem, requests appear over time at different positions of a metric space. A single agent traveling at unit speed must serve all requests, by visiting their positions, with the objective of minimizing the completion time. hits.title: How to Turn an Attention Neural Network into an Interpretable Hard-Logic Predicate Circuit: Truth-Table Predicate Extraction and State-Machine Merging under Ship-of-Theseus Replacement
hits.abstract_snippet: We convert a trained attention network as a whole, attention included, into a hard-logic predicate circuit that runs in its place.
